blocks.text: Cautionary Note Regarding Forward Looking Statements

runs.text: This Form 10-K contains forward-looking statements including statements regarding the Company’s implementation of its business plan and expected timelines for meeting its objectives, the need for capital to fund and grow its operations, and liquidity, and the Company's proposed business combination and related financing, closing conditions and expected changes to its business, operations, management and capital structure. Forward-looking statements can be identified by words such as “anticipates,” “intends,” “plans,” “seeks,” “believes,” “estimates,” “expects” and similar references to future periods. Forward-looking statements are based on our current expectations and assumptions regarding our business, the economy and other future conditions. Because forward-looking statements relate to the future, they are subject to inherent uncertainties, risks and changes in circumstances that are difficult to predict. Our actual results may differ materially from those contemplated by the forward-looking statements. We caution you therefore against relying on any of these forward-looking statements. They are neither statements of historical fact nor guarantees or assurances of future performance. The results anticipated by any or all of these forward-looking statements might not occur. Important factors, uncertainties and risks that may cause actual results to differ materially from these forward-looking statements are described in Item 1A. – Risk Factors. We undertake no obligation to publicly update or revise any forward-looking statements, whether as the result of new information, future events or otherwise.

Because the Company is a shell company, the safe harbor provisions of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995 (the “PSLRA”) do not apply to forward-looking statements made by the Company. Investors should not rely on the protections afforded by the PSLRA when evaluating forward-looking statements contained in this Form 10-K.

Integral Technologies, Inc. (“Integral,” the “Company” or “we”) was incorporated under the laws of the State of Nevada on February 12, 1996. The Company currently has no material revenue-generating operations. The Company is focused on maintaining its status as an SEC reporting company and identifying, evaluating and pursuing strategic transactions, including a merger, acquisition, reverse merger or other business combination with an operating business.

At present, the Company has no material operating business and its principal business objective is to complete a business combination. As a result, the Company is a “shell company” as defined in Rule 12b-2 under the Exchange Act. See Item 1A - Risk Factors beginning on page 4. The Company intends to pursue the completion of a business combination and, in connection therewith or thereafter, seek to establish or restore an active market for its securities, subject to applicable securities laws and market requirements.

The Company has identified and is actively advancing a potential business combination involving the proposed acquisition of an 80% membership interest in Apex North LLC (“Apex North”). The Company has devoted management time and resources to evaluating, negotiating and advancing the proposed transaction.

The Company is currently evaluating and advancing the proposed business combination. The proposed transaction remains subject to the completion of applicable transaction documentation, satisfaction or waiver of applicable closing conditions, financing and other matters. See Note 13 – Subsequent Events to the consolidated financial statements for additional information regarding the proposed transaction.

There can be no assurance that the proposed transaction will be completed on the terms currently contemplated or at all. If completed, the transaction is expected to result in a material change to the Company's business, operations, management and capital structure.

During fiscal 2026, a significant portion of the Company's activities and expenditures related to maintaining its SEC reporting status and evaluating potential strategic transactions. The Company is currently focused on advancing the proposed acquisition of an 80% membership interest in Apex North. There can be no assurance that the Company will successfully complete the proposed Apex North transaction or, if that transaction is not completed, any other business combination. See Item 1A - Risk Factors.

Historically, the Company developed and commercialized ElectriPlast®, an electrically and thermally conductive resin-based material. The Company does not currently conduct material revenue-generating operations relating to ElectriPlast® and is not actively pursuing the commercialization of this technology.

In 2019, the Company sold certain bipolar plate (“biplate”) technology and related intellectual property to Pivotal Battery Corp. (“Pivotal”), a company whose Chairman, James Eagan, is also Chairman of the Company’s Board of Directors.

On September 15, 2023, one of the two outstanding Series B Preferred Stockholders transferred its ownership of 40 Series B Preferred Shares (the “Series B Shares”) to Pivotal. On the same date, the Company and Pivotal entered into a Termination and Release Agreement pursuant to which:

rows: Pivotal agreed to relinquish its rights to the Series B Shares and transferred the shares to the Company. The Series B Shares were subsequently cancelled;
The Company agreed to release Pivotal from its obligations under the Technology Asset Purchase Agreement, including Pivotal’s remaining payment and share-issuance obligations under that agreement;

Pivotal agreed to issue 2,000,000 shares of its common stock on a pro-rata basis to all Company shareholders owning at least 12,500 shares of the Company’s common stock. The 2,000,000 Pivotal shares were required to be held in trust for the benefit of the shareholders entitled to receive them and are required to be distributed to those shareholders no later than December 31, 2027; and
Pivotal and the Company agreed to mutual general releases.

runs.text: As of June 30, 2026, the Pivotal shares had not been distributed to the Company’s shareholders. The Company has not assigned value to Pivotal shares and can provide no assurance that Pivotal will complete the distribution in accordance with applicable federal and state securities laws.

The Company has faced, and may continue to face, substantial competition in identifying and pursuing business combination opportunities. Such competition includes other public shell companies, special purpose acquisition companies, private equity firms, venture capital firms and other potential acquirers, many of which have substantially greater financial, technical and managerial resources than the Company. The market for attractive business combination opportunities is competitive. The Company's limited financial and human resources may place it at a competitive disadvantage in identifying, negotiating and completing a business combination.

If the proposed Apex North transaction is not completed, the Company may be required to resume or expand its search for another business combination opportunity and may face substantial competition in doing so.

As part of the proposed Apex North transaction or any other potential business combination, the Company may be required to negotiate with certain outstanding debt holders regarding the repayment, restructuring, conversion or other treatment of outstanding indebtedness. The inability to reach satisfactory arrangements with such debt holders could adversely affect the Company's ability to complete the proposed Apex North transaction or another business combination.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had no employees other than its executive officers, Doug Bathauer and James Eagan, who provide services to the Company under oral compensation arrangements. The Company relies on outside consultants and professional advisers for accounting, legal and other services. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's directors were James Eagan, Doug Bathauer and Michael Pruitt. Mr. Pruitt was appointed to the Board of Directors effective May 20, 2026, and serves as a non-employee director.
